chunks: And whatever was in it from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ.

key_terms.أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ: Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, part of the name of a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Ṣaffār, a named transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration through a chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the intermediary narrators linking the compiler to the source narrator.
